steps.text: Sir Rebral gives you another shield.

steps.npc: I'm Sir Rebral of the White Knights and taskmaster for the Falador Achievement Diary.

It's a diary that helps you keep track of particular achievements. In Falador and the surrounding area it can help you discover some quite useful things. Eventually, with enough exploration, the inhabitants will
reward you.
You can see the list of tasks on the side-panel.

options.text: I have a question about my Achievement Diary

steps.player: I have a question about my Achievement diary.

steps.npc: It's a diary that helps you keep track of particular achievements. In Falador and the surrounding area it can help you discover some quite useful things. Eventually, with enough exploration, the inhabitants will
reward you.
You can see the list of tasks on the side-panel.

Well, there are four different shields of Falador, which match up with the four levels of difficulty. Each has the same rewards as the previous level and some additional benefits too... which tier of rewards would you like to
know more about?

steps.player: Tell me more about the Easy rewards please!

steps.npc: If you complete all of the easy tasks in Falador, the shield can restore one quarter of your prayer points once per day and you can access a shortcut to the Chaos temple from Burthorpe.

steps.player: Tell me more about the Medium rewards please!

steps.npc: In addition to the easy rewards, the shield can restore half of your prayer points once per day and provides a 10% experience boost at Falador farm. You'll get an increased chance of finding a clue scroll from a Guard
and can access a shortcut within the Motherlode Mine

steps.player: Tell me more about the Hard rewards please!

steps.npc: In addition to the easy and medium benefits, the shield will restore all of your prayer points once per day, you can access a bank deposit box at the crafting guild and a shortcut to the Heroes' Guild fountain. The Giant
mole becomes much easier to locate and it will drop noted skins and claws.

steps.player: Tell me more about the Elite rewards please!

steps.npc: In addition to the previous tiers of rewards, the tree patch in Falador park will never become diseased and the shield will restore all of your prayer points twice per day in addition to an increased chance at higher level
ores from cleaning Pay-dirt.

options.text: How do I claim the rewards?

steps.player: How do I claim the rewards?

steps.npc: Just complete the tasks in the Falador area so they're ticked off, then come and speak to me for your rewards.
See you later.

easy-tasks-completed.player: I've completed all of the easy tasks in my Falador Achievement Diary!

easy-tasks-completed.npc: I can see that, well done! You'll be wanting your reward then!
This shield is a symbol of your exploration of Falador. It can restore one quarter of your prayer points once per day and you can now access a shortcut to the Chaos temple from Burthorpe.
If you ever lose your shield, come back to me to reclaim it.
